## Goals

-   Learn all the **main elements** that make up the R language
-   Learn the **general logic of programming**, useful with any language
-   Improve the way we approach problems and **make everyday work more efficient**

## How the lessons are organized

-   Theoretical and logical understanding of the topics
-   Understanding code output, error messages and special cases
-   Hands-on practice writing code and solving exercises

During the lessons we use a shared pad for the in-class exercises: keep it open!

[<i class="bi bi-pencil-square"></i> Open the in-class pad](https://etherpad.wikimedia.org/p/arca-corsoR){.btn-link-pill target="_blank"}

## Useful links

::: {.grid .links-grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-7 .lesson-card}
### <i class="bi bi-book"></i> Materials in English

-   [**Download R and RStudio**](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/){target="_blank"}: official installation page
-   [**Hands-On Programming with R**](https://rstudio-education.github.io/hopr/){target="_blank"}: a beginner-friendly introduction to programming in R
-   [**YaRrr! The Pirate's Guide to R**](https://bookdown.org/ndphillips/YaRrr/){target="_blank"}: an introduction to R for psychology students
-   [**Learning Statistics with R**](https://learningstatisticswithr.com/){target="_blank"}: R and statistics for psychology students
-   [**R for Data Science (2e)**](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/){target="_blank"}: importing, tidying, transforming and visualizing data
-   [**ggplot2: Elegant Graphics for Data Analysis**](https://ggplot2-book.org/){target="_blank"}: the reference book for plotting
-   [**Advanced R**](https://adv-r.hadley.nz/){target="_blank"}: for going deeper into how R works
-   [**An Introduction to R**](https://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/r-release/R-intro.html){target="_blank"}: the official manual from CRAN
-   [**Posit Cheatsheets**](https://posit.co/resources/cheatsheets/){target="_blank"}: one-page summaries of RStudio and common packages
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-5 .lesson-card}
### <i class="bi bi-github"></i> Course resources

-   [**Course repository**](https://github.com/arca-dpss/course-R-2425){target="_blank"} on GitHub

### <i class="bi bi-translate"></i> Materials in Italian

-   [**Introduction2R**](https://psicostat.github.io/Introduction2R/){target="_blank"}: open-source book on R
-   [**Installation guide**](https://ottaviae.github.io/test-organizzioni-fisppa/slides/01-IntroR/guida.html){target="_blank"} for R and RStudio
-   [**Additional exercises**](https://arca-dpss.github.io/course-R/exercises/esercizi-no-solutions.html){target="_blank"} by Filippo Gambarota
:::
:::
